title: Sendov's conjecture and the Phelps–Rodriguez conjecture
abstract: Proves Sendov's conjecture in full generality: if every zero of a complex polynomial of degree at least two lies in the closed unit disk, then every zero has a critical point within distance one. Also proves the Phelps–Rodriguez strengthening, with strict inequality unless the zero lies on the unit circle and the polynomial is a scalar multiple of z^n - a^n, and recovers Rubinstein's boundary theorem. Formalizes Tao's digestion of Lech Mazur's proof: the problem is reduced to a numerical inequality in the degree and one real parameter, settled by exact rational Bernstein certificates for degrees up to one hundred and by an analytic large-degree reduction beyond. Includes the top case of Maclaurin's inequality and multiset AM–GM, a defect inequality on the closed unit disk, a sharp bound on log(sinh h / h), kernel-checked polynomial certificate infrastructure, and a packed-exponentiation bridge for exact moment integrals.

informal.Sendov.sendov: For every natural number n at least two and every complex polynomial p of degree n all of whose roots have norm at most one, every root a of p admits a root of the derivative of p within distance at most one of a.
informal.Sendov.phelps_rodriguez: Under the same hypotheses, either some root of the derivative lies at distance strictly less than one from a, or a has norm one and p equals a nonzero scalar multiple of X^n - a^n.
informal.SendovConjecture.sendov: The same statement in the Mathlib-only form of the upstream statement of record: for every complex polynomial p of degree at least two such that every complex w with p(w) = 0 has norm at most one, every zero a of p admits a root of the derivative within distance at most one of a.
informal.Sendov.rubinstein_one: If a polynomial of degree n at least two with all roots in the closed unit disk vanishes at one, then either its derivative has a root within distance strictly less than one of the point one, or the polynomial equals its leading coefficient times X^n - 1.
informal.Sendov.stat_lt_one: For every degree n at least five and every real parameter alpha between zero and seventeen satisfying the feasibility constraint c^2 ≤ A, the quantity R n alpha of the blog post's equation stat is strictly less than one.
informal.Multiset.esymm_card_pred_le: For a nonempty multiset of nonnegative reals of cardinality m, the (m-1)-st elementary symmetric function is at most m times the (m-1)-st power of the mean.
informal.Multiset.prod_le_mean_pow: The product of a multiset of nonnegative reals is at most the mean raised to the cardinality.
informal.Sendov.defect: For a multiset of complex numbers in the closed unit disk, the product of the norms times the sum of the norms of 1/z minus the conjugate of z is at most one minus the square of that product.
informal.Sendov.log_sinh_div_le: For every positive real h, the logarithm of sinh h divided by h is at most the square root of h^2 + 9 minus three.
informal.Sendov.pev_pos_of_bern: If the Bernstein expansion of an integer coefficient list on an interval from zero to p/q equals p^d times a polynomial P and every Bernstein coefficient is positive, then P is positive on that interval.
